senses.gloss:
अनेक अन्-एक, अस्, आ, अम्, not one, many,
much; separated.
—अनेक-कालम्, ind. a long time,
for a long time.
—अनेककालावधि (˚ल-अव्˚), ind.
long since.
—अनेक-कृत्, त्, m. doing much, epithet
of Śiva.
—अनेक-गोत्र, अस्, m. having more families
than one, i. e. two, belonging to two families (or to
one as an adopted son).
—अनेक-चर, अस्, आ, अम्,
gregarious.
—अनेक-चित्त-मन्त्र, अस्, m. one whose
counsels are many-minded.
—अनेक-ज, अस्, आ, अम्,
born more than once; (अस्), m. a bird.
—अनेक-ता,
f. or अनेक-त्व, अम्, n. muchness, manifold condi-
tion.
—अनेक-त्र, ind. in many places.
—अनेक-
धर्म-कथा, f. different exposition of the law.
—अनेक-धा, ind. in various ways, often.
—अनेक-
धा-प्रयोग, अस्, m. using several times.
—अनेक-
प, अस्, आ, अम्, drinking oftener than once; (अस्, आ),
m. f. an elephant, because he drinks with his trunk
and with his mouth.
—अनेक-भार्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
having more wives than one.
—अनेक-मुख, अस्, आ,
अम्, having several faces, having different ways.
—अनेक-युद्ध-विजयिन्, ई, m. victorious in many
battles.
—अनेक-रन्ध्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having many
holes, weaknesses or troubles.
—अनेक-रूप, अस्, आ,
अम्, multiform; of various kinds or sorts; fickle, of
variable mind.
—अनेक-लोचन, अस्, m. having seve-
ral (three) eyes, N. of Śiva.
—अनेक-वचन, अम्,
n. the plural number.
—अनेक-वर्ण, (in arithmetic
compounded with various words to denote) many un-
known quantities (colours representing x, y, z, &c.),
e. g. अनेक-वर्ण-गुणन, multiplication of many
unknown quantities. (Similarly, if for गुणन
be substituted भजन ‘division,’ मध्यमाह-
रण ‘taking away the middle term,’ व्यवकलन
‘subtraction,’ सङ्कलन ‘addition,’ other algebraical
processes may be expressed).
—अनेक-वारम्, ind.
many times, repeatedly.
—अनेक-विध, अस्, आ, अम्,
of many kinds, in different ways, various.
—अनेक-
शफ, अस्, आ, अम्, cloven-hoofed.
—अनेक-शब्द,
अस्, आ, अम्, expressed by several words, synonymous.
—अनेक-शस्, ind. in great numbers, several times,
repeatedly, by large numbers or quantities.
—अनेका-
कार (˚क-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, multiform.
—अनेका-
क्षर (˚क-अक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, polysyllabic, having
more than one syllable.
—अनेकाग्र (˚क-अग्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, engaged in various pursuits.
—अनेकाच् (˚क-
अच्), having more than one vowel or syllable (अच् in
gram. being the technical term for vowel).
—अने-
कार्थ (˚क-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having more than one
meaning (as a word).
—अनेकार्थ-ध्वनि-मञ्-
जरी, f. and अनेकार्थ-सङ्ग्रह, अस्, m. titles of
two works on such words.
—अनेकाल् (˚क-अल्), con-
sisting of more than one अल् or letter (in the technical
phras. of gram.).
—अनेकाश्रय (˚क-आश्˚), अस्, m. or
[]
अनेकाश्रित (˚क-आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, (in Vaiśeṣika
phil.) dwelling, abiding in more than one.
अन्-एकाकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, not alone, accompanied by.

अन्-एकान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, not alone and excluding
every other, uncertain.
—अनेकान्त-त्व, अम्, n. un-
certainty.
—अनेकान्त-वाद, अस्, m. scepticism.
—अनेकान्त-वादिन्, ई, m. a sceptic; a Jaina, an
Arhat of the Jainas.
अनेकी-करण, अम्, n. making manifold.

अनेकी-भवत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, being manifold, i. e.
divided in two.
अनेकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, having several.

अनेजत् अन्-एजत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (rt. एज् with
अन्), not moving, immoveable.

अनेड अन्-एड, अस्, m. (अन् being an expletive
or denoting comparison), stupid, foolish.

अन्-एड-मूक, अस्, आ, अम्, deaf and dumb; blind;
wicked, fraudulent.

अनेद्य 1. अ-नेद्य, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. निद्), Ved.
not to be blamed.

अनेद्य 2. अ-नेद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. अ and
नेद्यस्, a contraction of नेदीयस्?), Ved. not near,
infinite.

अनेन 1. अन्-एन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according
to native authorities) sinless, faultless; (according to
German scholars) without a variegated set (of horses).
See एत.

अनेन 2. अनेन, अस्, m. (fr. इन and अन
for अन्); this doubtful word may signify one who has
no superior, ‘a sovereign or paramount lord;’ see इन
and अन for अन्.

अन्-एनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, blameless, sinless, not liable
to error; N. of various personages.
अन्-एनस्य, अम्, n. freedom from fault, sin.
अनेमन् अ-नेमन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. to be praised.
अनेव अन्-एव, ind. otherwise (?), or (?).

अनेहस् अन्-एहस्, आ, आ, अस् (fr. rt. ईह् with अन्),
Ved. without a rival, incomparable, unattainable; un-
menaced, unobstructed; (आ), m. time.

आ-नेतव्य or आ-नेय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be brought,
to be fetched.
आनेतव्य आ-नेतव्य, आ-नेय. See under आ-नी.
आ-नेतृ, ता, m. a bringer, bringing.
